name: DAAD Development-Related Postgraduate Courses (EPOS)
covers: full DAAD scholarship incl. monthly stipend (exact benefits per DAAD call; not itemised here)
application_window: varies by course, roughly Aug–Oct for the following year (approximate; DAAD says see each course announcement)
notes: Pakistan eligible; apply directly to a listed German EPOS course, which forwards candidates to DAAD; relevant work experience typically required.

name: DAAD Helmut-Schmidt-Programme (Public Policy and Good Governance)
covers: full DAAD scholarship incl. monthly stipend (exact benefits per DAAD call)
application_window: approx. Jun–Jul (DAAD Pakistan lists end of July)
notes: Pakistan is on the eligible-country list; covers public policy, law, economics and administration master's courses only.

name: DAAD Doctoral Programmes in Germany
covers: monthly stipend plus DAAD standard allowances (exact benefits per DAAD call)
application_window: approx. Jun–Aug (DAAD Pakistan lists end of August)
notes: Full doctoral programme (up to ~3 years) at a German university; Pakistan eligible.

name: DAAD Research Grants (short-term, in Germany)
covers: monthly stipend plus DAAD standard allowances (exact benefits per DAAD call)
application_window: approx. Jun–Aug (DAAD Pakistan lists end of August)
notes: 2–12 month research stays for doctoral candidates and postdocs; Pakistan eligible.

name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters scholarships
covers: participation/tuition costs, monthly living allowance, travel and visa
application_window: approx. Oct–Jan (each programme sets its own deadline)
notes: Open to students worldwide including PK; apply directly to each joint master's consortium.

name: Chevening Scholarships
covers: tuition, monthly living allowance, return economy flights, visa cost, arrival/departure allowances
notes: Pakistan eligible; one-year taught master's for applicants with work experience.

name: Commonwealth Master's Scholarships
provider: Commonwealth Scholarship Commission in the UK
covers: tuition, monthly stipend, return airfare, study travel grant
application_window: approx. Sep–Oct (national nominator, e.g. HEC, often closes earlier)
notes: Pakistan is on the eligible list; applicants must be nominated by a national nominating agency, not apply directly.

name: Commonwealth PhD Scholarships
provider: Commonwealth Scholarship Commission in the UK
covers: tuition, monthly stipend, return airfare, fieldwork and family allowances
application_window: approx. Sep–Oct (national nominator often closes earlier)
notes: Pakistan is one of 17 eligible countries; 36 months of full-time PhD; requires nomination.

name: Commonwealth Shared Scholarships
provider: Commonwealth Scholarship Commission in the UK with UK universities
covers: tuition, monthly stipend, return airfare
application_window: approx. Nov–Feb (universities nominate to CSC in March)
notes: Pakistan is on the eligible list; master's only, at participating UK universities; 2026/27 round closed.

name: France Excellence Eiffel Scholarship
provider: French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs / Campus France
covers: monthly allowance, travel, health insurance (tuition exempt at public institutions)
application_window: approx. Oct–Jan (submitted by the French institution)
notes: Any foreign national (PK included); the French institution applies for you; age limits 29 (master's) and 35 (PhD).

name: Italian Government (MAECI) Scholarships for Foreign Students
covers: allowance paid in instalments; tuition exemption only where the university grants it
notes: Pakistan had awardees for 2025–26 (Italian Embassy Islamabad ranking); 2026–27 country list not viewable, so re-check yearly on studyinitaly.esteri.it.

name: Invest Your Talent in Italy (IYT)
covers: stipend, tuition exemption, Italian course, mandatory company internship
notes: Pakistan is NOT eligible for 2026–27 (official list has 23 countries) despite blogs claiming otherwise.

name: Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships
covers: CHF 2,450 monthly stipend, health insurance (non-EU), return flight allowance; tuition NOT covered
application_window: approx. Aug–Oct (Pakistan: opens late Aug, closes end Oct)
notes: Pakistan offered PhD and Research Fellowship types via the Swiss Embassy Islamabad; Master's holders only, max age 35.

name: NL Scholarship (formerly Holland Scholarship)
provider: Dutch Ministry of Education / Dutch institutions
covers: EUR 5,000 one-off in first year
application_window: approx. Nov–May (deadlines set by each institution)
notes: Partial award only; open to non-EEA nationals including PK.

name: Orange Knowledge Programme (OKP)
provider: Nuffic / Dutch Ministry of Foreign Affairs
covers: (discontinued)
notes: DISCONTINUED: OKP ended in 2024; no new rounds.

name: SI Scholarship for Global Professionals
covers: tuition, monthly allowance, travel grant, insurance
application_window: approx. Oct–Jan (programme admission) then Feb (SI scholarship)
notes: Pakistan is NOT on the current 34-country list.

name: Fulbright Degree Program (Pakistan)
covers: tuition, textbooks, airfare, living stipend, health insurance
notes: Pakistan-specific programme run by USEFP; GRE required; clinical medicine excluded.

name: NSF Graduate Research Fellowship Program (GRFP)
covers: stipend plus cost-of-education allowance to the institution (3 years)
notes: NOT open to Pakistani nationals: US citizens, nationals and permanent residents only.

name: US-Pakistan Knowledge Corridor PhD Scholarships
covers: tuition and stipend (HEC terms)
notes: Pakistani/AJK nationals only; PhD at US universities; HEC service bond applies.

name: Canada Graduate Research Scholarship – Doctoral (CGRS D; replaced Vanier)
covers: CAD 40,000 per year for 3 years
notes: Vanier no longer accepts applications; international applicants (up to 15% of awards) must already be enrolled in a Canadian doctoral programme.

name: Australia Awards Scholarships (Pakistan)
covers: tuition, return airfare, establishment allowance, living contribution, health cover
notes: Pakistan eligible for master's only; requires 5 years' work experience and residence in Pakistan.

name: Japanese Government (MEXT) Scholarship – Research Students
covers: tuition, monthly stipend, airfare (amounts per annual MEXT guidelines)
application_window: approx. Apr–May for the Pakistan embassy track (recent deadline late May)
notes: Pakistan applicants apply via the Embassy of Japan in Islamabad or Consulate in Karachi, or through university recommendation.

name: Global Korea Scholarship (GKS) – Graduate
covers: tuition, monthly allowance, airfare, 1-year Korean language course
notes: Pakistan has an embassy-track quota via the Korean Embassy Islamabad; university track also available; under 40.

name: Chinese Government Scholarship – Bilateral Program
covers: full or partial scholarship (tuition, accommodation, stipend, insurance under full award)
notes: For Pakistan, HEC selects and nominates; the Chinese Embassy does not accept individual applications.

name: HEC Overseas Scholarships for MS/MPhil leading to PhD in Selected Fields (Phase-III)
covers: tuition and stipend (HEC terms)
notes: Pakistani/AJK nationals only; top-200 QS/THE universities in priority fields; HAT test and service bond required.

name: Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme (HKPFS)
covers: annual stipend (HK$344,400 in 2026/27) plus conference and research travel allowance (HK$14,400 a year)
notes: Open irrespective of country of origin; 400 fellowships for 2027/28; apply through a Hong Kong university.

name: Singapore International Graduate Award (SINGA)
provider: A*STAR with NUS, NTU and SUTD
covers: see official page
notes: PhD at A*STAR research institutes with a partner university; check current terms on the official page.

name: Research Training Program (RTP) scholarships
provider: Australian Government, awarded by each university
covers: tuition offset and living stipend (amounts set by each university)
application_window: per university; check each university's PhD application
notes: Open to international research students; apply through each Australian university's research degree application.

name: Manaaki New Zealand Scholarships
provider: New Zealand Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade
covers: tuition, living allowance, travel, insurance
notes: Pakistan is not eligible; eligible Asian countries listed here, plus Pacific countries (see official page).
